message: I'm not sure how this fits with the discussion, but our local paper in Spokane ran an article a few days ago about voting patterns, showing which parts of the county voted at the county average, and which precincts voted either 5 or 10 percent above or below the county average. The lowest turnout in the county, about 30 percent with the county average near 70 percent, was in the precinct that encompasses Fairchild Air Force Base. Sure, lots of them are somewhat transient, but with the new air tankers a big deal in the local elections (what with Boeing across the Cascades and Fairchild being a refueling base of KC-135s I think it is) and this being a fairly Republican region, one would expect them to vote, one way or the other. It would be interesting to look at voting rates at other military bases across the country to see how this level of engagement plays out and what it might mean. What are the beliefs and values at play here?
